title: Cyber Bots (Japan) V1.002: guarded later-load edit
summary: Select 1 MiB expansion RAM and deliver the upstream later-loaded NOP from the original disc sector.
rationale: Issue #50 reports boot and graphics faults in T-1217G V1.002. The original callback selects 1 MiB RAM, substitutes a handler for the first program's 0600D000 call target, NOPs one later-loaded instruction and jumps to that original target. This pack leaves the original call target untouched, selects the same cart mode and supplies the NOP in its source sector. A guard on FAD 303 checks the original call target's complete sector before the paired menu skips the callback. The candidate remains inactive pending physical gameplay acceptance. A later natural control executes the exact 24-byte compiled handler at its linked menu address 02008B38. With fixed region, clock and 1 MiB cart, all 201 four-field checkpoints and the complete 35379664-byte PCM stream match over 12000 frames. Full menu/MCU integration and physical cartridge switching remain unverified.

writes.effect: NOP the instruction later loaded at 0601695A for the exact V1.002 image.
writes.reason: The original Cyber Bots handler makes the same edit before jumping to the game's 0600D000 continuation.

guards.reason: Confirm the first program retains the original 0600D000 call target at raw offset 104 (RAM 060DD058); callback replacement must not inherit a foreign trampoline.
